song.title: I Know A Name
song.lyrics:
[V1] I know a name, that can silence roaring waves I know a name, that can empty out a grave I know a name, it's the only name that saves And it's worthy of all praise
[C1] I call You, Jesus I call You, I call You Healer Risen and reigning in power Something comes out of the grave Every time I call You, Jesus I call You, I call You Saviour Worthy of glory forever Something comes out of the grave Every time I call Your name
[V2] I have a King, with dominion over death He holds the keys, in His holy nail-scarred hands He is the heel, that has crushed the serpent's head Our resurrected Great I Am
[C2] I call You, Jesus I call You, I call You Healer Risen and reigning in power Something comes out of the grave Every time I call You, Jesus I call You, I call You Saviour Worthy of glory forever Something comes out of the grave Every time I call Your name
[B1] Chains break, dry bones wake Every time I call Your name The gates of Hell shake Every time I call Your name Chains break, dry bones wake Every time I call Your name The gates of Hell shake Every time I call Your name
[P1] Dead things come alive Dead things come alive Dead things come alive in the name of Jesus Dead things come alive Dead things come alive Dead things come alive in the name of Jesus x2
[C3] I call You, Jesus I call You, I call You Healer Risen and reigning in power Something comes out of the grave Every time I call You, Jesus I call You, I call You Savior Worthy of glory forever Something comes out of the grave Every time I call Your name
[B2] Chains break, dry bones wake Every time I call Your name The gates of Hell shake Every time I call Your name
[P2] Dead things come alive Dead things come alive Dead things come alive in the name of Jesus Dead things come alive Dead things come alive Dead things come alive in the name of Jesus
song.author: Elevation Worship, Brandon Lake, Chris Brown
